import pandas as pd

# --- Reconstruct the employment record (EMP-1001) ---
employment_record = pd.DataFrame([{
    "employee_id":     "EMP-1001",
    "employee_name":   "Jordan Lee",
    "position":        "Data Analyst",
    "department":      "Analytics",
    "manager":         "Alex Rivera",
    "start_date":      pd.Timestamp("2025-04-01"),
    "employment_type": "Full-time",
    "jurisdiction":    "California",
    "effective_date":  pd.Timestamp("2025-04-01"),
    "end_date":        pd.NaT,
    "status":          "Active",
    "record_created":  pd.Timestamp("2026-10-12"),
}])

# --- Compensation details ---
annual_salary   = 85_000.00
pay_frequency   = "Bi-weekly"
pay_periods_yr  = 26                       # bi-weekly = 26 pay periods/year
per_period_pay  = annual_salary / pay_periods_yr
eff_date        = pd.Timestamp("2025-04-01")

# 401(k) eligibility: 90 days after effective date
k401_elig_date  = eff_date + pd.Timedelta(days=90)

comp = {
    "annual_salary":            annual_salary,
    "currency":                 "USD",
    "pay_frequency":            pay_frequency,
    "pay_periods_per_year":     pay_periods_yr,
    "per_period_gross":         round(per_period_pay, 2),
    "benefits_health_insurance": True,
    "benefits_401k_eligible":    True,
    "benefits_401k_wait_days":   90,
    "benefits_401k_elig_date":   k401_elig_date,
    "comp_effective_date":       eff_date,
    "comp_end_date":             pd.NaT,        # open-ended
}

for k, v in comp.items():
    employment_record[k] = v

for col in ["benefits_401k_elig_date", "comp_effective_date", "comp_end_date"]:
    employment_record[col] = pd.to_datetime(employment_record[col])

# --- Validation ---
print("=== Compensation Record ===")
print(f"Annual Salary:        ${annual_salary:,.2f} {comp['currency']}")
print(f"Pay Frequency:        {pay_frequency} ({pay_periods_yr} periods/year)")
print(f"Gross per Period:     ${per_period_pay:,.2f}")
print(f"Health Insurance:     {'Included' if comp['benefits_health_insurance'] else 'None'}")
print(f"401(k) Eligible:      {'Yes' if comp['benefits_401k_eligible'] else 'No'} "
      f"(after {comp['benefits_401k_wait_days']} days)")
print(f"401(k) Elig. Date:    {k401_elig_date.date()}  (eff {eff_date.date()} + 90 days)")
print(f"Comp Effective Date:  {employment_record.loc[0,'comp_effective_date'].date()}")

# Math check
print(f"\nCheck: ${per_period_pay:,.2f} x {pay_periods_yr} = ${per_period_pay*pay_periods_yr:,.2f} "
      f"(target ${annual_salary:,.2f})")

# Alignment check
aligned = employment_record.loc[0,"comp_effective_date"] == employment_record.loc[0,"effective_date"]
print(f"Aligns with employment effective date: {aligned}")

print("\n=== Full Record (transposed) ===")
with pd.option_context("display.max_rows", None, "display.width", 200):
    print(employment_record.T.to_string())

aligned = employment_record.loc[0,"comp_effective_date"] == employment_record.loc[0,"effective_date"]

import pandas as pd

    "position":        "Data Analyst",

    "manager":         "Alex Rivera",
    "start_date":      pd.Timestamp("2025-04-01"),

    "jurisdiction":    "California",

    "status":          "Active",
    "record_created":  pd.Timestamp("2026-10-12"),
}])

# --- Compensation details ---
annual_salary   = 85_000.00
pay_frequency   = "Bi-weekly"
pay_periods_yr  = 26                       # bi-weekly = 26 pay periods/year
per_period_pay  = annual_salary / pay_periods_yr
eff_date        = pd.Timestamp("2025-04-01")

# 401(k) eligibility: 90 days after effective date
k401_elig_date  = eff_date + pd.Timedelta(days=90)

comp = {
    "annual_salary":            annual_salary,
    "currency":                 "USD",
    "pay_frequency":            pay_frequency,
    "pay_periods_per_year":     pay_periods_yr,
    "per_period_gross":         round(per_period_pay, 2),
    "benefits_health_insurance": True,
    "benefits_401k_eligible":    True,
    "benefits_401k_wait_days":   90,
    "benefits_401k_elig_date":   k401_elig_date,
    "comp_effective_date":       eff_date,
    "comp_end_date":             pd.NaT,        # open-ended
}

for k, v in comp.items():
    employment_record[k] = v

print(f"Pay Frequency:        {pay_frequency} ({pay_periods_yr} periods/year)")
print(f"Gross per Period:     ${per_period_pay:,.2f}")
print(f"Health Insurance:     {'Included' if comp['benefits_health_insurance'] else 'None'}")

      f"(after {comp['benefits_401k_wait_days']} days)")

print(f"Comp Effective Date:  {employment_record.loc[0,'comp_effective_date'].date()}")

      f"(target ${annual_salary:,.2f})")

# Alignment check
aligned = employment_record.loc[0,"comp_effective_date"] == employment_record.loc[0,"effective_date"]
print(f"Aligns with employment effective date: {aligned}")

print("\n=== Full Record (transposed) ===")
with pd.option_context("display.max_rows", None, "display.width", 200):
    print(employment_record.T.to_string())

    "benefits_401k_elig_date":   k401_elig_date,

# Alignment check
aligned = employment_record.loc[0,"comp_effective_date"] == employment_record.loc[0,"effective_date"]
print(f"Aligns with employment effective date: {aligned}")

}])

# --- Compensation details ---
annual_salary   = 85_000.00
pay_frequency   = "Bi-weekly"
pay_periods_yr  = 26                       # bi-weekly = 26 pay periods/year
per_period_pay  = annual_salary / pay_periods_yr
eff_date        = pd.Timestamp("2025-04-01")

# 401(k) eligibility: 90 days after effective date
k401_elig_date  = eff_date + pd.Timedelta(days=90)

comp = {
    "annual_salary":            annual_salary,
    "currency":                 "USD",

    "pay_periods_per_year":     pay_periods_yr,
    "per_period_gross":         round(per_period_pay, 2),
    "benefits_health_insurance": True,
    "benefits_401k_eligible":    True,
    "benefits_401k_wait_days":   90,
    "benefits_401k_elig_date":   k401_elig_date,
    "comp_effective_date":       eff_date,
    "comp_end_date":             pd.NaT,        # open-ended
}

print(f"Pay Frequency:        {pay_frequency} ({pay_periods_yr} periods/year)")

print(f"Comp Effective Date:  {employment_record.loc[0,'comp_effective_date'].date()}")

# Math check
print(f"\nCheck: ${per_period_pay:,.2f} x {pay_periods_yr} = ${per_period_pay*pay_periods_yr:,.2f} "
      f"(target ${annual_salary:,.2f})")

# Alignment check
aligned = employment_record.loc[0,"comp_effective_date"] == employment_record.loc[0,"effective_date"]
print(f"Aligns with employment effective date: {aligned}")

print("\n=== Full Record (transposed) ===")
with pd.option_context("display.max_rows", None, "display.width", 200):
    print(employment_record.T.to_string())

pay_periods_yr  = 26                       # bi-weekly = 26 pay periods/year

eff_date        = pd.Timestamp("2025-04-01")

comp = {

    "currency":                 "USD",

    "benefits_401k_eligible":    True,
    "benefits_401k_wait_days":   90,
    "benefits_401k_elig_date":   k401_elig_date,
    "comp_effective_date":       eff_date,
    "comp_end_date":             pd.NaT,        # open-ended

      f"(target ${annual_salary:,.2f})")

# Alignment check
aligned = employment_record.loc[0,"comp_effective_date"] == employment_record.loc[0,"effective_date"]
print(f"Aligns with employment effective date: {aligned}")

print("\n=== Full Record (transposed) ===")
with pd.option_context("display.max_rows", None, "display.width", 200):

```python
import pandas as pd

# --- Reconstruct the employment record (EMP-1001) ---
employment_record = pd.DataFrame([{
    "employee_id":     "EMP-1001",
    "employee_name":   "Jordan Lee",
    "position":        "Data Analyst",
    "department":      "Analytics",
    "manager":         "Alex Rivera",
    "start_date":      pd.Timestamp("2025-04-01"),
    "employment_type": "Full-time",
    "jurisdiction":    "California",
    "effective_date":  pd.Timestamp("2025-04-01"),
    "end_date":        pd.NaT,
    "status":          "Active",
    "record_created":  pd.Timestamp("2026-10-12"),
}])

# --- Compensation details ---
annual_salary   = 85_000.00
pay_frequency   = "Bi-weekly"
pay_periods_yr  = 26                       # bi-weekly = 26 pay periods/year
per_period_pay  = annual_salary / pay_periods_yr
eff_date        = pd.Timestamp("2025-04-01")

# 401(k) eligibility: 90 days after effective date
k401_elig_date  = eff_date + pd.Timedelta(days=90)

comp = {
    "annual_salary":            annual_salary,
    "currency":                 "USD",
    "pay_frequency":            pay_frequency,
    "pay_periods_per_year":     pay_periods_yr,
    "per_period_gross":         round(per_period_pay, 2),
    "benefits_health_insurance": True,
    "benefits_401k_eligible":    True,
    "benefits_401k_wait_days":   90,
    "benefits_401k_elig_date":   k401_elig_date,
    "comp_effective_date":       eff_date,
    "comp_end_date":             pd.NaT,        # open-ended
}

for k, v in comp.items():
    employment_record[k] = v

for col in ["benefits_401k_elig_date", "comp_effective_date", "comp_end_date"]:
    employment_record[col] = pd.to_datetime(employment_record[col])

# --- Validation ---
print("=== Compensation Record ===")
print(f"Annual Salary:        ${annual_salary:,.2f} {comp['currency']}")
print(f"Pay Frequency:        {pay_frequency} ({pay_periods_yr} periods/year)")
print(f"Gross per Period:     ${per_period_pay:,.2f}")
print(f"Health Insurance:     {'Included' if comp['benefits_health_insurance'] else 'None'}")
print(f"401(k) Eligible:      {'Yes' if comp['benefits_401k_eligible'] else 'No'} "
      f"(after {comp['benefits_401k_wait_days']} days)")
print(f"401(k) Elig. Date:    {k401_elig_date.date()}  (eff {eff_date.date()} + 90 days)")
print(f"Comp Effective Date:  {employment_record.loc[0,'comp_effective_date'].date()}")

# Math check
print(f"\nCheck: ${per_period_pay:,.2f} x {pay_periods_yr} = ${per_period_pay*pay_periods_yr:,.2f} "
      f"(target ${annual_salary:,.2f})")

# Alignment check
aligned = employment_record.loc[0,"comp_effective_date"] == employment_record.loc[0,"effective_date"]
print(f"Aligns with employment effective date: {aligned}")

print("\n=== Full Record (transposed) ===")
with pd.option_context("display.max_rows", None, "display.width", 200):
    print(employment_record.T.to_string())
```
